description: Audited authentic non-LeetCode company-specific online assessment questions across 25 top product and enterprise engineering firms.
source: Candidate-reported actual OAs (HackerRank, HackerEarth, CodeSignal, Codility, AMCAT, Mettl, University placement repositories)

records.title: Order Conversions (Binary Packet Parsing)
records.evidenceNote: Annotated actual Amazon SDE Online Assessment 2024 question on HackerRank. Verified from candidate assessment memory dump and CMake test harness.
records.statement: Write a function that takes a serialized set of orders in a designated memory format and converts them to an OrderBatch data structure. Each serialized packet starts with a 32-bit header (0xFACE6420), followed by order count, payload size, timestamp, and an array of Order records. Return the parsed batch or an error code if the header magic or CRC checksum fails.

records.title: Starting in a Bit (Non-Aligned Pattern Search)
records.evidenceNote: Annotated actual Amazon SDE Online Assessment 2024 question on HackerRank. Verified from candidate assessment test harness with sample inputs and byte conversions.
records.statement: Given a byte array in network byte order, write an algorithm to find the starting bit position of the first occurrence of the 32-bit big-endian pattern (0xFE6B2840). The pattern may or may not be byte-aligned in the input byte stream. Return the 0-indexed starting bit offset, or -1 if the pattern is not found.

records.title: Algorithm Swap (Inversion Evaluation)
records.evidenceNote: Annotated actual Amazon SDE Online Assessment 2021 question on HackerRank. Verified from candidate assessment test harness.
records.statement: Evaluate the efficiency of an old sorting algorithm that repeatedly identifies the lexicographically smallest pair of indices (i, j) with i < j such that arr[i] > arr[j], and swaps them. Determine the total number of swap operations performed until the distinct integer array arr is sorted in ascending order.

records.title: Robot Rodeo (Bounded Trajectory Simulation)
records.evidenceNote: Annotated actual Amazon SDE Online Assessment 2021 question on HackerRank. Verified from candidate assessment test harness.
records.statement: For a robotics demonstration, a robot accepts instructions: G (move forward 1 step), L (turn left 90 degrees), and R (turn right 90 degrees). Given an array of instruction strings, determine for each string whether the robot is guaranteed to remain in a bounded circular region if the instructions are executed infinitely in a loop. Return "YES" or "NO" for each command sequence.

records.title: Prioritize Prime Orders (Alphanumeric Log Sorting)
records.evidenceNote: Annotated actual Amazon SDE AMCAT Online Assessment question. Verified from candidate debrief repository.
records.statement: Amazon prioritizes orders where Prime orders contain metadata of lowercase words following an alphanumeric identifier, while non-Prime orders contain space-delimited positive integers. Sort the orders so that all Prime orders appear before non-Prime orders. Prime orders are sorted lexicographically by metadata (breaking ties with identifier), while non-Prime orders maintain their relative original order.

records.title: Optimal Flight Route Utilization
records.evidenceNote: Annotated actual Amazon SDE AMCAT Online Assessment question. Verified from candidate debrief repository.
records.statement: Amazon Prime Air assigns forward and backward shipping routes to aircraft with maximum operating travel distance maxTravelDist. Given forwardRouteList and returnRouteList of pairs [id, distance], find all pairs of route IDs [forwardId, returnId] whose combined distance is less than or equal to maxTravelDist and closest to maxTravelDist.

records.title: Cell State Competition (Neighbor Transition)
records.evidenceNote: Annotated actual Amazon SDE AMCAT Online Assessment question. Verified from candidate debrief repository.
records.statement: Eight houses arranged in a straight line compete with adjacent cells daily. An active cell is 1, inactive is 0. If both neighbors of a cell are either active or inactive, the cell becomes inactive next day; otherwise active. Non-existent outer edges are always inactive (0). Return the cell states after k days.

records.title: Bounty (Pirate Wealth Modulo Combinatorics)
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Amazon 2025 campus recruitment OA. Verified from placement questions debrief blog.
records.statement: A pirate captain allocates bounty as an N-digit integer without leading zeroes. To maintain security, the allocated number must contain at least two zeroes among its digits. Calculate the number of valid N-digit bounty codes modulo 10^4 + 7.

records.title: Customer Priority Order Matching
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Amazon FTE 2026 recruitment drive online assessment.
records.statement: Given available inventory of an item and a list of buyers where each buyer has [id, wantedQuantity, bidPrice, orderTime], allocate items by prioritizing highest bid price first, then earlier order time, and finally smaller ID. Return the list of IDs of unfulfilled customers.

records.title: Binary Array Minimum Swap Sorting
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Amazon FTE 2026 recruitment drive online assessment.
records.statement: Given a binary array of 0s and 1s, find the minimum number of adjacent swaps required to group all 0s together on one side (either all 0s first or all 1s first). Return the minimum between sorting zeroes first and sorting ones first.

records.title: Distinct Decimal Values of Binary Subsequences
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and working solution from Google 2024 campus online assessment.
records.statement: Given a binary string S of length n consisting only of "0" and "1", find the decimal values of all non-empty subsequences. Leading zeroes in a subsequence do not create distinct numerical values (e.g., "01" and "1" both evaluate to decimal 1). Return the number of distinct decimal values modulo 10^9 + 7.

records.title: Substrings with More Ones than Zeros
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and working solution from Google 2024 campus online assessment.
records.statement: Given a string S containing only 0s and 1s, determine the total number of substrings that contain strictly more 1s than 0s. A substring is a contiguous sequence of characters.

records.title: Second Shortest Time in Weighted Graph
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and working solution from Google Engineering Apprenticeship 2027 recruitment online assessment.
records.statement: Given a weighted directed graph with n vertices and m edges with positive weights, find the second strictly shortest time to travel from node 1 to node n. If no second shortest path exists, return -1.

records.title: Target Calibration Cost Transformation
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and working solution from Google Engineering Apprenticeship 2027 recruitment online assessment.
records.statement: Starting from initial calibration level 1, you can perform two operations to reach target level n: add 1 (cost 1), or multiply by calibration multiplier b (cost 1). Find the minimum total cost to reach target level n.

records.title: Employee Office Signed Distance Filter
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Wells Fargo 2024 campus placement OA.
records.statement: Given an array distances of size n representing signed employee office positions (- left, + right) relative to origin 0, and integers [start, end], return all employee distances that satisfy start <= distances[i] <= end while preserving order.

records.title: Overlapping String Pattern Occurrences
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Wells Fargo 2024 campus placement OA.
records.statement: Given text string S of length n and pattern string P of length m, determine the number of times P occurs in S, including overlapping occurrences.

records.title: Eulerian Single Edge Graph Traversal
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Wells Fargo 2024 campus placement OA.
records.statement: Given an undirected connected graph with V vertices and E edges, determine whether it is possible to traverse the graph such that every edge is traversed exactly once (Eulerian path/circuit). Return 1 if possible, 0 otherwise.

records.title: Work Hours Schedule Pattern Completion
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from BNY Mellon 2024 campus placement OA on HackerRank.
records.statement: An employee must work exactly W hours per week, with daily hours not exceeding maxDaily. A 7-character pattern string is given where known daily hours are digits (0-8) and missing days are question marks (?). Return all valid 7-day schedule strings sorted lexicographically that sum to exactly W hours.

records.title: Equalize Layers Parity Steps
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from BNY Mellon 2024 campus placement OA on HackerRank.
records.statement: A network structure contains n layers with different capacities. In each operation, you can increase a layer by 1 on odd days and 2 on even days. Determine the minimum number of days required to make all layers equal in capacity to the maximum layer.

records.title: Compatible Warehouse Pairs on Weighted Tree
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from BNY Mellon 2024 campus placement OA on HackerRank.
records.statement: HackerLand has a network of warehouses represented as a rooted weighted tree with n nodes rooted at node 1. Each warehouse v has assigned value val[v]. A pair (u, v) is compatible if u is an ancestor of v and distance(u, v) <= val[v]. Find the total number of compatible warehouse pairs.

records.title: Distinct Ways to Transform S into T by Deletions
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Trilogy Innovations 2024 campus recruitment OA.
records.statement: Given two strings S and T, determine the number of distinct ways to transform S into T by deleting some (or none) of the characters in S without rearranging the remaining characters. Return the result modulo 10^9 + 7.

records.title: Mario Floating Wooden Platform River Crossing
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Trilogy Innovations 2024 campus recruitment OA.
records.statement: Mario stands on platform 0 and needs to reach bank A + 1 across a river of width A. Mario can jump up to B units forward or backward. There are M movable wooden platforms of given lengths floating on the river that cannot overlap. Find if Mario can place the platforms such that he can cross the river, and return the optimal platform layout.

records.title: Dual Matrix State Reconstruction Queries
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Trilogy Innovations 2024 campus recruitment OA.
records.statement: Two M*M matrices X and Y are filled with +1 or -1 values. You receive N queries revealing the value of X[r][c] and Y[r][c] alongside row/column parity constraints. Determine whether a consistent matrix assignment exists after each query.

records.title: Maximum Profit Job Skill Matching
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Trilogy Innovations 2024 campus recruitment OA.
records.statement: A company has N job openings with required skill masks and profits P[i]. There are M candidates with known skill sets. Each candidate can be assigned to at most one job for which they possess all required skills. Determine the maximum profit the company can achieve by assigning candidates to jobs.

records.title: Palindrome Counts Centered at Query Indices
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Media.net 2024 campus online assessment.
records.statement: Given a string A of lowercase alphabets of size N and an array B of Q query indices, return an array C of size Q where C[i] is the number of odd-length palindromic substrings centered at index B[i].

records.title: Flat Earth Social Distancing Red Zone Coverage
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Media.net 2024 campus online assessment.
records.statement: A group of people are located at coordinates (x[i], y[i]) on a 2D plane. Red zones of radius R expand from designated infected centers. Determine the minimum radius R such that at least K people are contained within the union of red zones.

records.title: Activation Energy Threshold Optimization
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Adobe 2024 recruitment online assessment.
records.statement: Given n modules with energy ratings energy[i] and activation costs cost[i], you may activate at most k modules. Activating a module boosts system efficiency if its energy meets or exceeds active thresholds. Determine the maximum net energy achievable within cost budget B.

records.title: Grid Maze Shortest Path with Obstacle Jumps
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from NPCI 2024 recruitment online assessment.
records.statement: Given an n*m grid where 0 is an open cell and 1 is an obstacle, find the minimum moves to travel from top-left (0,0) to bottom-right (n-1,m-1). You can eliminate up to k obstacles along the path. Return -1 if unreachable.

records.title: BST Preorder Traversal Verification
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from NPCI 2024 recruitment online assessment.
records.statement: Given an array of distinct integers, determine whether it represents a valid preorder traversal sequence of a Binary Search Tree (BST). Return "YES" or "NO".

records.title: Product Delivery Order ID Decomposition
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from NatWest Group 2024 online assessment.
records.statement: Each order in a distribution warehouse has an encoded orderID. For each orderID, calculate the product delivery count by summing all positive prime factors of digits in orderID. Return the delivery array for all queried orders.

records.title: Dominant Project Working Weeks Scheduling
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from NatWest Group 2024 online assessment.
records.statement: An engineering team has projects requiring modules projC[i] to be developed in alternating weekly milestones. No two modules from the same project can be executed in consecutive weeks. Determine the maximum number of working weeks the team can remain active without violating the constraint.

records.title: Smallest Prime Non-Divisor MEX of Subarrays
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from SkySecure AI 2024 recruitment online assessment.
records.statement: For any subarray of integers A, define its prime-MEX as the smallest prime p such that at least one element in the subarray is NOT divisible by p. Calculate the sum of prime-MEX values across all contiguous subarrays of array A.

records.title: Subtree Independent Weight Maximization
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from SkySecure AI 2024 recruitment online assessment.
records.statement: Given a tree with N nodes rooted at node 1 where each node u has an intrinsic label u, select a subset of nodes such that each selected node dominates its entire subtree unless disjoint descendant subtrees achieve a strictly greater sum. Return the maximum achievable score at the root.

records.title: K-Partition Minimized Maximum-Minimum Difference Cost
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Zorvyn 2024 recruitment online assessment.
records.statement: Partition an array A of size N into exactly K non-empty contiguous subarrays. The cost of a subarray is defined as (max_element - min_element) multiplied by its length. Determine the minimum total cost across all K partitions.

records.title: Dijkstra with Magical Zero-Weight Bridges
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Zorvyn 2024 recruitment online assessment.
records.statement: A transportation network has n cities, m regular toll roads with positive travel times, and k bidirectional magical bridges with 0 travel time. Find the shortest travel time from city 1 to city n using any combination of roads and bridges.

records.title: Subset Sum to Prime Modulo 10^9+7
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and verified solution from Zorvyn 2024 recruitment online assessment.
records.statement: Given an array A of N positive integers, find the number of non-empty subsets whose sum of elements is a prime number. Return the count modulo 10^9 + 7.

records.title: Minimizing Array Cost by Element Insertion
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and Java solution from Athenahealth 2025 campus recruitment OA on HackerRank.
records.statement: The cost of an array is defined as the sum of squared differences between adjacent elements: sum((arr[i] - arr[i-1])^2). You are permitted to insert exactly one integer element at any position in the array. Determine the minimum possible array cost achievable after insertion.

records.title: Minimum Largest Plank Length for Road Hole Coverage
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and Java solution from SAP Labs 2025 campus recruitment OA.
records.statement: A road has holes located at positions given in an integer array holes. You have two wooden planks available to cover all holes. Determine the minimum possible length L of the longer plank such that both planks together cover every hole on the road.

records.title: User Concurrent Login Limit Session Counter
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and problem schema from Tekion 2025 campus recruitment OA.
records.statement: A multi-tenant system logs user sessions with [userId, loginTime, logoutTime]. A security policy dictates that no user may exceed K concurrent active logins at any timestamp. Return all user IDs that violated the policy along with the maximum concurrent session peak.

records.title: Vulnerability Matrix Row Selection
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report and pseudocode from Tekion 2025 campus recruitment OA.
records.statement: Given an N*M vulnerability risk matrix where entry (i, j) indicates security risk of microservice j under server configuration i, select exactly K server configurations (rows) such that the maximum column vulnerability across all microservices is minimized.

records.title: LED Seven-Segment Display Transition Flips
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Morgan Stanley 2024 campus recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Count the number of segment toggles in an LED 7-segment display when rendering the decimal digits of a given number sequentially, starting from all segments OFF. Each transition from digit D_i to D_{i+1} counts the number of segments flipped from on to off or off to on.

records.title: Alternating Work Type Schedule Optimization
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Morgan Stanley campus recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: An engineering schedule has n days with task indicators (1 = Rest, 2 = Type A, 3 = Type B, 4 = Either A or B). An engineer cannot perform the same work type on two consecutive days. Find the minimum number of rest days required across the n days.

records.title: Euclidean Transformation Reachability (Is Possible)
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from JPMorgan Chase 2024 recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given integer coordinate pair (a, b), you may transition via (a + b, b) or (a, a + b) in any order. Determine whether target coordinate (c, d) is reachable from (a, b).

records.title: Highly Profitable Months Streaks
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from JPMorgan Chase recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given monthly stock prices over n months and analysis parameter k, find the number of contiguous periods of length k where stock prices are strictly increasing month-over-month.

records.title: Bit-Flipping Subsegment Optimization
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Cisco 2024 campus recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given a binary array of size n, you are permitted to invert all bits in exactly one contiguous subsegment [L, R] (changing 0s to 1s and 1s to 0s). Determine the maximum number of 1s achievable in the entire array after performing the operation at most once.

records.title: Network Packet Subsequence Uniqueness
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Cisco recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: In network packet monitoring, find the length of the longest contiguous subsegment where the frequency of every packet type is at most K.

records.title: Concatenation Pairs Target Match
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from PhonePe 2024 campus online assessment on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given an array of positive integers and target string X, find the number of ordered pairs (i, j) with i != j such that the string concatenation of numbers[i] and numbers[j] equals X.

records.title: Matrix Frequency Sorting with Deterministic Order
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from PhonePe recruitment online assessment on HackerEarth. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given an N*N matrix of integers, rearrange its elements across the matrix in row-major order sorted by ascending frequency of occurrence, breaking frequency ties by numerical value in ascending order.

records.title: Valid Non-Degenerate Triangle Subsets
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from PhonePe recruitment OA on DoSelect. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given an array of stick lengths, find the number of distinct triplets (i, j, k) with i < j < k that satisfy the triangle inequality theorem (the sum of any two sides is strictly greater than the third side).

records.title: Permutation Sadness Minimal Transpositions
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from PhonePe campus recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: In transaction ordering, a sequence has sadness equal to the number of inversion pairs where a higher priority transaction appears after a lower priority one. Find the minimum adjacent swaps needed to bring the transaction sequence within permitted sadness tolerance S.

records.title: Optimal Walk Energy Step Minimization
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Walmart Global Tech 2024 campus recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Starting at position 0, you want to reach target destination N. You can take a single step forward (cost A), single step backward (cost B), or double your current position (cost C). Determine the minimum cost to reach N from 0.

records.title: Valid Palindromic String Construction with Character Limits
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Walmart Global Tech recruitment OA on HackerEarth. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given character frequency limits limit[c] for English lowercase letters and target length L, construct the lexicographically smallest palindromic string of length L that satisfies all frequency limits. If impossible, return "-1".

records.title: Subarray Frequency Thresholds Query
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Meesho 2024 campus recruitment OA on HackerEarth. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given an array of product catalog tags and Q queries of range [L, R] with threshold K, find the number of distinct catalog tags in [L, R] that appear with frequency at least K.

records.title: Weighted Job Scheduling with Resource Constraints
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Meesho recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given N logistics tasks each with [startTime, endTime, weight, workerCapacityNeeded], and M available worker pools, select a non-overlapping subset of tasks that maximizes total weight without exceeding pool capacity at any time.

records.title: Anagram Modification Distance Minimization
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Meesho recruitment OA on HackerEarth. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given two strings s1 and s2 of equal length, determine the minimum number of character modification operations required to make s1 and s2 anagrams of each other.

records.title: Helicopter Rescue Resource Allocation
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Razorpay 2024 campus recruitment OA on HackerEarth. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: A relief team operates rescue helicopters with weight capacity C. Each helicopter can carry at most 2 people whose combined weight does not exceed C. Given weights array of people, find the minimum number of helicopters needed to rescue everyone.

records.title: Threshold Subarray Size K Monotonic Check
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Razorpay recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: For payment audit streaming, find for each sliding window of size K in an incoming transaction amounts array whether the maximum transaction in the window exceeds a fraud risk threshold T and compute the total breach durations.

records.title: Minimizing Maximum Difference by Removing K Elements
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Razorpay recruitment OA on HackerEarth. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given an array A of N numbers, you can remove exactly K elements. Find the minimum possible value of (max_element - min_element) in the remaining N - K elements.

records.title: Special Substring Inversion Distance
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Flipkart 2024 campus recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given string S of size N and integer K, determine the number of distinct substrings of S whose inversion count (number of pairs i < j where S[i] > S[j]) is strictly less than K.

records.title: Graph Path Cost Optimization under Modulo
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Flipkart recruitment OA on Mettl. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: In a warehouse delivery grid with N vertices and M weighted edges, the travel cost along a path is the sum of edge weights modulo P. Find the path from source 1 to destination N that minimizes (total_sum % P).

records.title: Spiral Matrix State Transformation
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Salesforce 2024 campus recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given an M*N integer matrix, traverse its elements in spiral order while applying a state transition rule: elements at prime spiral step indices are multiplied by a growth coefficient K. Return the transformed flattened stream.

records.title: Triplets with Lexicographical Constraints
records.evidenceNote: First-hand candidate report from Salesforce recruitment OA on HackerRank. Verified from GeeksforGeeks interview debrief.
records.statement: Given an array A of N distinct integers, find the number of triplets (i, j, k) with i < j < k such that A[i] < A[j] < A[k] and A[k] - A[i] <= D.

records.title: String Without 3 Identical Consecutive Letters
records.evidenceNote: Verified Microsoft Codility Online Assessment task frequently reported by campus and industry candidates.
records.statement: Given string S of lowercase letters, return a string after removing the minimum number of letters such that the resulting string does not contain three identical consecutive letters.

records.title: Valid 24-Hour Times from Four Digits
records.evidenceNote: Verified Microsoft Codility Online Assessment task frequently reported by campus candidates.
records.statement: Given four integers A, B, C, D, count how many valid 24-hour times "HH:MM" (between "00:00" and "23:59") can be formed using each of the four integers exactly once.

records.title: Mutate Array with Adjacent Neighbor Sums
records.evidenceNote: Verified Uber CodeSignal General Coding Assessment (GCA) task reported in campus and off-campus recruitment.
records.statement: Given an integer n and an array a of length n, your task is to apply a mutation on a resulting in an array b of length n where b[i] = a[i - 1] + a[i] + a[i + 1]. For boundary elements a[-1] and a[n], consider their values to be 0.

records.title: Alternating Parity and Digit Sum Pair Counting
records.evidenceNote: Verified Uber CodeSignal General Coding Assessment (GCA) task reported in campus recruitment.
records.statement: Given an array of integers a, count the number of pairs (i, j) with i < j such that the sum of digits of a[i] equals the sum of digits of a[j], and the parity of the index difference (j - i) matches a given parity flag.
